scope: RTL scalar synchronous register-read backpressure correctness; shared-pool guest qualification pending
trigger: A synchronous register read completes while the issue slot is full. Its readValid metadata waits, but SyncReadMem does not retain a valid response in later disabled cycles.

guest_evidence.workload: gl_fade, runtime VLMAX shader, four shared 16-lane/eight-warp FPU-enabled CUs
guest_evidence.result: zero staging pointer; following vector load faults all16lanes

before.regression: ScalarRegisterMacroManagerSpec: retain both synchronous operands while issue is backpressured

fix: Capture both read operands on the first stalled response cycle and retain them until issue accepts the response. Reset the capture flag for every new read.
unstalled_behavior: No added pipeline cycle; consecutive independent request test still passes.

coverage: Delayed read retains both operands through six cycles of backpressure.
Pending fresh read launches when the saved response leaves; both request identities and operands are checked.
Unstalled synchronous reads, dependency forwarding, consecutive independent requests and scalar metadata alignment.
Seven-warps runtime VLMAX staging arithmetic, vector loads and exact stores on full FPU-enabled four-CU system.
Dependent instruction/data Sv32 walks with exact rounding outputs on full pool.
